title: On the Largest Convexity Number of Co-Finite Sets in the Plane
authors: Chaya Keller, Micha A. Perles
abstract: The convexity number of a set $X \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ is the minimum number of convex subsets required to cover it. We study the following question: what is the largest possible convexity number $f(n)$ of $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$, where $S$ is a set of $n$ points in general position in the plane? We prove that for all $n \geq 4$, $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor \leq f(n) \leq \frac{7n+44}{11}$. We also show that for every $n \geq 4$, if the points of $S$ are in convex position then the convexity number of $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$ is $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor$. This solves a problem of Lawrence and Morris [Finite sets as complements of finite unions of convex sets, Disc. Comput. Geom. 42 (2009), 206-218].
zh_title: 关于平面上共有限集的最大凸性数
translation: 我们研究以下问题：在平面上，移除 $n$ 个点集 $S$ 后，剩余集合 $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$ 的最大可能凸性数 $f(n)$ 是多少？我们证明了对于所有 $n \geq 4$， $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor \leq f(n) \leq \frac{7n+44}{11}$。我们还证明了对于任何 $n \geq 4$，如果 $S$ 中的点位于凸位置，则 $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$ 的凸性数为 $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor$。这解决了 Lawrence 和 Morris 的一个问题。
tldr: 研究了从平面中移除 $n$ 个点后，剩余区域（共有限集）所需的最小凸覆盖数（凸性数）的最大值 $f(n)$ 的范围，并对点集呈凸排布的情况给出了精确解。
ai_comments: 该论文的主要创新在于确定了移除平面上 $n$ 个点后，剩余共有限集（co-finite set）的凸性数的上下界，并对点集位于凸位置的特殊情况给出了精确解，解决了先前研究中的一个问题。其重要性在于为几何覆盖问题提供了更精确的理论界限。局限性在于上界和下界之间仍存在差距，且仅考虑了一般位置和凸位置的点集。
motivation: 研究平面上移除有限点集后，剩余共有限集的最小凸覆盖所需的凸子集数量（即凸性数）的最大可能值，旨在解决 Lawrence 和 Morris 提出的问题。
method: 通过研究 $n$ 个点的集合 $S$ 在平面 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 上的移除后剩余集合 $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$ 的凸性数，推导出其上下界。对于 $S$ 在凸位置的情况，直接确定了精确值。
results: 证明了对于所有 $n \geq 4$， $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor \leq f(n) \leq \frac{7n+44}{11}$。此外，证明了如果 $S$ 中的点位于凸位置，则 $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$ 的凸性数为 $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor$。
conclusion: 对于 $n \geq 4$，移除了 $n$ 个点后剩余集合的凸性数 $f(n)$ 满足 $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor \leq f(n) \leq \frac{7n+44}{11}$。当 $S$ 中的点位于凸位置时，凸性数精确为 $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor$。

title: Generative Conditional Missing Imputation Networks
authors: George Sun, Yi-Hui Zhou
abstract: In this study, we introduce a sophisticated generative conditional strategy designed to impute missing values within datasets, an area of considerable importance in statistical analysis. Specifically, we initially elucidate the theoretical underpinnings of the Generative Conditional Missing Imputation Networks (GCMI), demonstrating its robust properties in the context of the Missing Completely at Random (MCAR) and the Missing at Random (MAR) mechanisms. Subsequently, we enhance the robustness and accuracy of GCMI by integrating a multiple imputation framework using a chained equations approach. This innovation serves to bolster model stability and improve imputation performance significantly. Finally, through a series of meticulous simulations and empirical assessments utilizing benchmark datasets, we establish the superior efficacy of our proposed methods when juxtaposed with other leading imputation techniques currently available. This comprehensive evaluation not only underscores the practicality of GCMI but also affirms its potential as a leading-edge tool in the field of statistical data analysis.

title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Quantum-Informed Property Predictions in Artificial Sensing Materials
authors: Li Chen, Leonardo Medrano Sandonas, Shirong Huang, Alexander Croy, Gianaurelio Cuniberti
abstract: Digital sensing faces challenges in developing sustainable methods to extend the applicability of customized e-noses to complex body odor volatilome (BOV). To address this challenge, we developed MORE-ML, a computational framework that integrates quantum-mechanical (QM) property data of e-nose molecular building blocks with machine learning (ML) methods to predict sensing-relevant properties. Within this framework, we expanded our previous dataset, MORE-Q, to MORE-QX by sampling a larger conformational space of interactions between BOV molecules and mucin-derived receptors. This dataset provides extensive electronic binding features (BFs) computed upon BOV adsorption. Analysis of MORE-QX property space revealed weak correlations between QM properties of building blocks and resulting BFs. Leveraging this observation, we defined electronic descriptors of building blocks as inputs for tree-based ML models to predict BFs. Benchmarking showed CatBoost models outperform alternatives, especially in transferability to unseen compounds. Explainable AI methods further highlighted which QM properties most influence BF predictions. Collectively, MORE-ML combines QM insights with ML to provide mechanistic understanding and rational design principles for molecular receptors in BOV sensing. This approach establishes a foundation for advancing artificial sensing materials capable of analyzing complex odor mixtures, bridging the gap between molecular-level computations and practical e-nose applications.

title: Towards a conjecture on long induced rainbow paths in triangle-free graphs
authors: N.R. Aravind, Shiwali Gupta, Rogers Mathew
abstract: Given a triangle-free graph $G$ with chromatic number $k$ and a proper vertex coloring $φ$ of $G$, it is conjectured that $G$ contains an induced rainbow path on $k$ vertices under $φ$. Scott and Seymour proved the existence of an induced rainbow path on $(\log \log \log k)^{\frac{1}{3}- o(1)}$ vertices. We improve this to $(\log k)^{\frac{1}{2}- o(1)}$ vertices. Further, we prove the existence of an induced path that sees $\frac{k}{2}$ colors.

title: Parametrized Sharing for Multi-Agent Hybrid DRL for Multiple Multi-Functional RISs-Aided Downlink NOMA Networks
authors: Chi-Te Kuo, Li-Hsiang Shen, Jyun-Jhe Huang
abstract: Multi-functional reconfigurable intelligent surface (MF-RIS) is conceived to address the communication efficiency thanks to its extended signal coverage from its active RIS capability and self-sustainability from energy harvesting (EH). We investigate the architecture of multi-MF-RISs to assist non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) downlink networks. We formulate an energy efficiency (EE) maximization problem by optimizing power allocation, transmit beamforming and MF-RIS configurations of amplitudes, phase-shifts and EH ratios, as well as the position of MF-RISs, while satisfying constraints of available power, user rate requirements, and self-sustainability property. We design a parametrized sharing scheme for multi-agent hybrid deep reinforcement learning (PMHRL), where the multi-agent proximal policy optimization (PPO) and deep-Q network (DQN) handle continuous and discrete variables, respectively. The simulation results have demonstrated that proposed PMHRL has the highest EE compared to other benchmarks, including cases without parametrized sharing, pure PPO and DQN. Moreover, the proposed multi-MF-RISs-aided downlink NOMA achieves the highest EE compared to scenarios of no-EH/amplification, traditional RISs, and deployment without RISs/MF-RISs under different multiple access.

title: Splitting Precoding with Subspace Selection and Quantized Refinement for Massive MIMO
authors: Yasaman Khorsandmanesh, Emil Bjornson, Joakim Jalden
abstract: Limited fronthaul capacity is a practical bottleneck in massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) 5G architectures, where a base station (BS) consists of an advanced antenna system (AAS) connected to a baseband unit (BBU). Conventional downlink designs place the entire precoding computation at the BBU and transmit a high-dimensional precoding matrix over the fronthaul, resulting in substantial quantization losses and signaling overhead. This letter proposes a splitting precoding architecture that separates the design between the AAS and BBU. The AAS performs a local subspace selection to reduce the channel dimensionality, while the BBU computes an optimized quantized refinement precoding based on the resulting effective channel. The numerical results show that the proposed splitting precoding strategy achieves higher sum spectral efficiency than conventional one-stage precoding.

title: AceFF: A State-of-the-Art Machine Learning Potential for Small Molecules
authors: Stephen E. Farr, Stefan Doerr, Antonio Mirarchi, Francesc Sabanes Zariquiey, Gianni De Fabritiis
abstract: We introduce AceFF, a pre-trained machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) optimized for small molecule drug discovery. While MLIPs have emerged as efficient alternatives to Density Functional Theory (DFT), generalizability across diverse chemical spaces remains difficult. AceFF addresses this via a refined TensorNet2 architecture trained on a comprehensive dataset of drug-like compounds. This approach yields a force field that balances high-throughput inference speed with DFT-level accuracy. AceFF fully supports the essential medicinal chemistry elements (H, B, C, N, O, F, Si, P, S, Cl, Br, I) and is explicitly trained to handle charged states. Validation against rigorous benchmarks, including complex torsional energy scans, molecular dynamics trajectories, batched minimizations, and forces and anergy accuracy demonstrates that AceFF establishes a new state-of-the-art for organic molecules. The AceFF-2 model weights and inference code are available at https://huggingface.co/Acellera/AceFF-2.0.

title: Three results on twisted $G-$codes and skew twisted $G-$codes
authors: Alvaro Otero Sanchez
abstract: In this paper we solve an open question formulated in the original paper of twisted skew group codes regarding when a twisted skew group code is checkable. Also, we prove that all ideals of dimension 3 over a twisted group algebra are abelian group codes, generalising another previous result over group algebras. Finally, we prove a bound on the dimension and distance of a twisted group code, as well as when such bound is reached.

title: Quantum Simulation of Protein Fragment Electronic Structure Using Moment-based Adaptive Variational Quantum Algorithms
authors: Biraja Ghoshal
abstract:
Background: Understanding electronic interactions in protein active sites is fundamental to drug discovery and enzyme engineering, but remains computationally challenging due to exponential scaling of quantum mechanical calculations.
  Results: We present a quantum-classical hybrid framework for simulating protein fragment electronic structure using variational quantum algorithms. We construct fermionic Hamiltonians from experimentally determined protein structures, map them to qubits via Jordan-Wigner transformation, and optimize ground state energies using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver implemented in pure Python. For a 4-orbital serine protease fragment, we achieve chemical accuracy (< 1.6 mHartree) with 95.3% correlation energy recovery. Systematic analysis reveals three-phase convergence behaviour with exponential decay (α = 0.95), power law optimization (γ = 1.21), and asymptotic approach. Application to SARS-CoV-2 protease inhibition demonstrates predictive accuracy (MAE=0.25 kcal/mol), while cytochrome P450 metabolism predictions achieve 85% site accuracy.
  Conclusions: This work establishes a pathway for quantum-enhanced biomolecular simulations on near-term quantum hardware, bridging quantum algorithm development with practical biological applications.
comment: Keywords: quantum computing, variational quantum eigensolver, protein fragments, electronic structure, drug discovery, enzyme engineering

title: Assessing Quantum Annealing to Solve the Minimum Vertex Multicut
authors: Ali Abbassi, Yann Dujardin, Eric Gourdin, Philippe Lacomme, Caroline Prodhon
abstract: Cybersecurity in telecommunication networks often leads to hard combinatorial optimization problems that are challenging to solve with classical methods. This work investigates the practical feasibility of using quantum annealing to address the Restricted Vertex Minimum Multicut Problem. The problem is formulated as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization model and implemented on D-Wave s quantum annealer. Rather than focusing on solution quality alone, we analyze key aspects of the quantum workflow including minor embedding techniques, chain length, topology constraints, chain strength selection, unembedding procedures, and postprocessing. Our results show that quantum annealing faces substantial hardware-level constraints limitations in embedding and scalability, especially for large instances, while hybrid quantum-classical solvers provide improved feasibility. This study offers a realistic assessment of the D-Wave system s current capabilities and identifies crucial parameters that govern the success of quantum optimization in cybersecurity-related network problems.

title: Quantum Approaches to the Minimum Edge Multiway Cut Problem
authors: Ali Abbassi, Yann Dujardin, Eric Gourdin, Philippe Lacomme, Caroline Prodhon
abstract: We investigate the minimum edge multiway cut problem, a fundamental task in evaluating the resilience of telecommunication networks. This study benchmarks the problem across three quantum computing paradigms: quantum annealing on a D-Wave quantum processing unit, photonic variational quantum circuits simulated on Quandela s Perceval platform, and IBM s gate-based Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA). We assess the comparative feasibility of these approaches for early-stage quantum optimization, highlighting trade-offs in circuit constraints, encoding overhead, and scalability. Our findings suggest that quantum annealing currently offers the most scalable performance for this class of problems, while photonic and gate-based approaches remain limited by hardware and simulation depth. These results provide actionable insights for designing quantum workflows targeting combinatorial optimization in telecom security and resilience analysis.

title: Density-Based Algorithms for Corruption-Robust Contextual Search and Convex Optimization
authors: Renato Paes Leme, Chara Podimata, Jon Schneider
abstract:
We study the problem of contextual search, a generalization of binary search in higher dimensions, in the adversarial noise model. Let $d$ be the dimension of the problem, $T$ be the time horizon and $C$ be the total amount of adversarial noise in the system. We focus on the $ε$-ball and the symmetric loss. For the $ε$-ball loss, we give a tight regret bound of $O(C + d \log(1/ε))$ improving over the $O(d^3 \log(1/ε) \log^2(T) + C \log(T) \log(1/ε))$ bound of Krishnamurthy et al (Operations Research '23). For the symmetric loss, we give an efficient algorithm with regret $O(C+d \log T)$. To tackle the symmetric loss case, we study the more general setting of Corruption-Robust Convex Optimization with Subgradient feedback, which is of independent interest.
  Our techniques are a significant departure from prior approaches. Specifically, we keep track of density functions over the candidate target vectors instead of a knowledge set consisting of the candidate target vectors consistent with the feedback obtained.
comment: Extended abstract accepted at COLT22. This is a significantly updated version

title: Dynamic Gap: Safe Gap-based Navigation in Dynamic Environments
authors: Max Asselmeier, Dhruv Ahuja, Abdel Zaro, Ahmad Abuaish, Ye Zhao, Patricio A. Vela
abstract: This paper extends the family of gap-based local planners to unknown dynamic environments through generating provable collision-free properties for hierarchical navigation systems. Existing perception-informed local planners that operate in dynamic environments rely on emergent or empirical robustness for collision avoidance as opposed to performing formal analysis of dynamic obstacles. In addition to this, the obstacle tracking that is performed in these existent planners is often achieved with respect to a global inertial frame, subjecting such tracking estimates to transformation errors from odometry drift. The proposed local planner, dynamic gap, shifts the tracking paradigm to modeling how the free space, represented as gaps, evolves over time. Gap crossing and closing conditions are developed to aid in determining the feasibility of passage through gaps, and a breadth of simulation benchmarking is performed against other navigation planners in the literature where the proposed dynamic gap planner achieves the highest success rate out of all planners tested in all environments.
comment: Accepted to 2025 International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)

title: Modeling Epidemic Dynamics of Mutant Strains with Evolutionary Game-based Vaccination Behavior
authors: Wenjie Zhang, Yusheng Li, Qin Li, Guojun Huang, Minyu Feng
abstract: The outbreak of mutant strains and vaccination behaviors have been the focus of recent epidemiological research, but most existing epidemic models failed to simultaneously capture viral mutation and consider the complexity and behavioral dynamics of vaccination. To address this gap, we develop an extended SIRS model that distinguishes infections with the original strain and a mutant strain, and explicitly introduces a vaccinated compartment state. At the behavioral level, we employ evolutionary game theory to model individual vaccination decisions, where strategies are determined by both neighbors' choices and the current epidemiological situation. This process corresponds to the time-varying vaccination rate of susceptible individuals transitioning to vaccinated individuals at the epidemic spreading level. We then couple the epidemic and vaccination behavioral processes through the microscopic Markov chain approach (MMCA) and finally investigate the evolutionary dynamics via numerical simulations. The results show that our framework can effectively mitigate outbreaks across different disease scenarios. Sensitivity analysis further reveals that vaccination uptake is most strongly influenced by vaccine cost, efficacy, and perceived risk of side effects. Overall, this behavior-aware modeling framework captures the co-evolution of viral mutation and vaccination behavior, providing quantitative and theoretical support for designing effective public health vaccination policies.

title: Distributed Sparse Linear Regression under Communication Constraints
authors: Rodney Fonseca, Boaz Nadler
abstract: In multiple domains, statistical tasks are performed in distributed settings, with data split among several end machines that are connected to a fusion center. In various applications, the end machines have limited bandwidth and power, and thus a tight communication budget. In this work we focus on distributed learning of a sparse linear regression model, under severe communication constraints. We propose several two round distributed schemes, whose communication per machine is sublinear in the data dimension. In our schemes, individual machines compute debiased lasso estimators, but send to the fusion center only very few values. On the theoretical front, we analyze one of these schemes and prove that with high probability it achieves exact support recovery at low signal to noise ratios, where individual machines fail to recover the support. We show in simulations that our scheme works as well as, and in some cases better, than more communication intensive approaches.

title: Stability and Convergence of HDG Schemes under Minimal Regularity
authors: Jiannan Jiang, Noel J. Walkington, Yukun Yue
abstract: Convergence and compactness properties of approximate solutions to elliptic partial differential computed with the hybridized discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) are established. While it is known that solutions computed using the HDG scheme converge at optimal rates to smooth solutions, this does not establish the stability of the method or convergence to solutions with minimal regularity. The compactness and convergence results show that the HDG scheme can be utilized for the solution of nonlinear problems and linear problems with non-smooth coefficients on domains with reentrant corners.

title: Understanding the Research-Practice Gap in Visualization Design Guidelines
authors: Nam Wook Kim, Grace Myers, Jinhan Choi, Yoonsuh Cho, Changhoon Oh, Yea-Seul Kim
abstract: Although empirical research often underpins practical visualization guidelines, it remains unclear how well these research-driven insights are reflected in the guidelines practitioners actually use. In this paper, we investigate the research-practice gap in visualization design guidelines through a mixed-methods approach. We collected 390 design guidelines from practitioner-facing sources and 235 empirical studies to quantitatively assess their alignment. To complement this analysis, we conducted surveys with 69 participants (33 practitioners, 36 researchers) and in-depth interviews with 20 experts to examine their experiences, perceptions, and challenges. Our findings reveal discrepancies: empirical evidence often contradicts or only partially supports widely used guidelines, and the two communities prioritize different attributes of design. Based on these insights, we derive a holistic guideline template (integrating Context, Approach, Problem, and Purpose) and discuss actionable strategies, such as a triadic knowledge model.

title: Efficient Multi-Task Scene Analysis with RGB-D Transformers
authors: Söhnke Benedikt Fischedick, Daniel Seichter, Robin Schmidt, Leonard Rabes, Horst-Michael Gross
abstract: Scene analysis is essential for enabling autonomous systems, such as mobile robots, to operate in real-world environments. However, obtaining a comprehensive understanding of the scene requires solving multiple tasks, such as panoptic segmentation, instance orientation estimation, and scene classification. Solving these tasks given limited computing and battery capabilities on mobile platforms is challenging. To address this challenge, we introduce an efficient multi-task scene analysis approach, called EMSAFormer, that uses an RGB-D Transformer-based encoder to simultaneously perform the aforementioned tasks. Our approach builds upon the previously published EMSANet. However, we show that the dual CNN-based encoder of EMSANet can be replaced with a single Transformer-based encoder. To achieve this, we investigate how information from both RGB and depth data can be effectively incorporated in a single encoder. To accelerate inference on robotic hardware, we provide a custom NVIDIA TensorRT extension enabling highly optimization for our EMSAFormer approach. Through extensive experiments on the commonly used indoor datasets NYUv2, SUNRGB-D, and ScanNet, we show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance while still enabling inference with up to 39.1 FPS on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 32 GB.
comment: Published in Proc. International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN 2023)

title: Stochastic dual coordinate descent with adaptive heavy ball momentum for linearly constrained convex optimization
authors: Yun Zeng, Deren Han, Yansheng Su, Jiaxin Xie
abstract: The problem of finding a solution to the linear system $Ax = b$ with certain minimization properties arises in numerous scientific and engineering areas. In the era of big data, the stochastic optimization algorithms become increasingly significant due to their scalability for problems of unprecedented size. This paper focuses on the problem of minimizing a strongly convex function subject to linear constraints. We consider the dual formulation of this problem and adopt the stochastic coordinate descent to solve it. The proposed algorithmic framework, called adaptive stochastic dual coordinate descent, utilizes sampling matrices sampled from user-defined distributions to extract gradient information. Moreover, it employs Polyak's heavy ball momentum acceleration with adaptive parameters learned through iterations, overcoming the limitation of the heavy ball momentum method that it requires prior knowledge of certain parameters, such as the singular values of a matrix. With these extensions, the framework is able to recover many well-known methods in the context, including the randomized sparse Kaczmarz method, the randomized regularized Kaczmarz method, the linearized Bregman iteration, and a variant of the conjugate gradient (CG) method. Additionally, we introduce an equivalent formulation that, in certain cases, substantially reduces the need for full-dimensional vector operations introduced by the momentum term. We prove that, with strongly admissible objective function, the proposed method converges linearly in expectation. Numerical experiments are provided to confirm our results.
comment: To appear in Numerische Mathematik. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2305.05482

title: Empirical Study on the Representation of 3D Scatterplots as 2D Figures
authors: Philippos Papaphilippou, Lucy Hederman
abstract: 3D scatterplots are a well-established plotting technique that can be used to represent data with three or more dimensions. On paper and computer monitors they are essentially two-dimensional projections of the three-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system. This transition from the 3D space to two dimensions is not done consistently among scientific software, as there is currently limited quantifiable evidence on the effectiveness of each approach. Notably, the frequent lack of visual cues such as with regard to depth perception is equivalent to a reduction of dimensionality by one. Hence, their use in manuscripts is less common or straightforward. In this empirical study, an online survey is conducted within an academic institution to identify and quantify the effectiveness of feature or feature combinations on 3D scatterplots in terms of reading time and accuracy.
zh_title: 三维散点图表示为二维图形的实证研究
translation: 三维散点图是一种成熟的绘图技术，可用于表示具有三个或更多维度的数据。在纸张和电脑显示器上，它们本质上是三维笛卡尔坐标系的二维投影。由于目前缺乏关于各种方法有效性的量化证据，科学软件在从三维空间到二维的这种转换方面做法不一致。值得注意的是，经常缺乏深度感知等视觉线索，这相当于维度降低了一维。因此，它们在手稿中的使用较不常见或不直接。在这项实证研究中，在一家学术机构内进行了一项在线调查，旨在根据阅读时间和准确性来识别和量化三维散点图中特征或特征组合的有效性。
tldr: 研究人员进行了一项在线实证调查，旨在量化不同特征或特征组合在将三维散点图投影到二维时（如在论文或屏幕上）对阅读时间和准确性的影响，以解决现有科学软件表示不一致且缺乏量化证据的问题。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它试图对传统的三维数据可视化方法（三维散点图）的二维表示进行量化评估。虽然三维散点图很常见，但研究指出，缺乏一致的表示方法和深度线索会严重影响其有效性。通过实证研究和量化指标（阅读时间和准确性），该研究有望为科学软件和手稿中三维图表的最佳实践提供明确的、基于证据的指导，填补现有知识的空白。
motivation: 三维散点图在纸张和电脑显示器上本质上是三维坐标系的二维投影。然而，科学软件在实现这种二维投影时缺乏一致性，且目前缺乏关于各种方法有效性的量化证据。此外，经常缺乏深度感知等视觉线索，这相当于维度降低了一维，导致其在手稿中的使用不常见或不直接。

title: From Transformers to LLMs: A Systematic Survey of Efficiency Considerations in NLP
authors: Wazib Ansar, Saptarsi Goswami, Amlan Chakrabarti
abstract: The emergence of Transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) has substantially augmented the capabilities of Natural Language Processing (NLP), thereby intensifying the demand for computational resources. Therefore, enhancing efficiency based on factors like computational requirements, energy consumption, carbon footprint and financial cost has become a vital area of research. This motivates us to conduct a systematic literature review on Transformer-based LLMs in NLP from the perspective of efficiency. In this survey of 312 articles published between the years 2011 and 2025, efficiency-improvement endeavors have been systematically discussed targeting various aspects such as data curation, model design, model downsizing, and dynamic inferencing. This has been augmented with efficiency considerations in model adaptation strategies like pre-training, fine-tuning, prompt-engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Furthermore, a statistical analysis of the articles has been performed followed by an in-depth evaluation of the efficiency and efficacy of more than 30 renowned NLP models has been conducted on 13 evaluation benchmarks. This paper offers valuable insights for researchers, professionals as well as scholars, and explores the trend of research toward sustainable practices in NLP.
zh_title: 从Transformer到LLM：自然语言处理中效率考量的系统综述
translation: 基于Transformer的大型语言模型（LLMs）的出现显著增强了自然语言处理（NLP）的能力，从而加剧了对计算资源的需求。因此，提高基于计算要求、能耗、碳足迹和财务成本等因素的效率已成为一个至关重要的研究领域。这促使我们从效率的角度对NLP中基于Transformer的LLMs进行系统性的文献综述。在这项涵盖2011年至2025年间发表的312篇文章的综述中，系统地讨论了针对数据整理、模型设计、模型小型化和动态推理等各个方面的效率改进工作。同时，还补充了预训练、微调、提示工程和检索增强生成（RAG）等模型适应策略中的效率考量。此外，对文章进行了统计分析，并对30多个知名NLP模型在13个评估基准上的效率和有效性进行了深入评估。本文为研究人员、专业人士以及学者提供了宝贵的见解，并探索了NLP中迈向可持续实践的研究趋势。
tldr: 本文是对312篇关于Transformer和LLM效率的论文进行的系统综述。它讨论了如何通过数据整理、模型设计、模型小型化和适应策略（如RAG）来降低计算资源需求、能耗和成本，并评估了30多个模型的效率，旨在推动NLP的可持续发展。

motivation: 基于Transformer的大型语言模型（LLMs）的出现显著增强了自然语言处理（NLP）的能力，但也加剧了对计算资源的需求。因此，提高基于计算要求、能耗、碳足迹和财务成本等因素的效率已成为一个至关重要的研究领域。
method: 进行了一项系统的文献综述，涵盖2011年至2025年间的312篇文章。系统地讨论了针对数据整理、模型设计、模型小型化和动态推理等方面的效率改进工作。补充讨论了预训练、微调、提示工程和检索增强生成（RAG）等模型适应策略中的效率考量。此外，对文章进行了统计分析，并对30多个知名NLP模型在13个评估基准上的效率和有效性进行了深入评估。

title: Evolutionary Optimization of Physics-Informed Neural Networks: Advancing Generalizability by the Baldwin Effect
authors: Jian Cheng Wong, Chin Chun Ooi, Abhishek Gupta, Pao-Hsiung Chiu, Joshua Shao Zheng Low, My Ha Dao, Yew-Soon Ong
abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are at the forefront of scientific machine learning, making possible the creation of machine intelligence that is cognizant of physical laws and able to accurately simulate them. However, today's PINNs are often trained for a single physics task and require computationally expensive re-training for each new task, even for tasks from similar physics domains. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a pioneering approach to advance the generalizability of PINNs through the framework of Baldwinian evolution. Drawing inspiration from the neurodevelopment of precocial species that have evolved to learn, predict and react quickly to their environment, we envision PINNs that are pre-wired with connection strengths inducing strong biases towards efficient learning of physics. A novel two-stage stochastic programming formulation coupling evolutionary selection pressure (based on proficiency over a distribution of physics tasks) with lifetime learning (to specialize on a sampled subset of those tasks) is proposed to instantiate the Baldwin effect. The evolved Baldwinian-PINNs demonstrate fast and physics-compliant prediction capabilities across a range of empirically challenging problem instances with more than an order of magnitude improvement in prediction accuracy at a fraction of the computation cost compared to state-of-the-art gradient-based meta-learning methods. For example, when solving the diffusion-reaction equation, a 70x improvement in accuracy was obtained while taking 700x less computational time. This paper thus marks a leap forward in the meta-learning of PINNs as generalizable physics solvers. Sample codes are available at https://github.com/chiuph/Baldwinian-PINN.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Evolutionary Computation
zh_title: 物理信息神经网络的进化优化：通过鲍德温效应提升泛化能力
translation: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）处于科学机器学习的前沿，使得创建能够感知物理定律并能准确模拟它们的机器智能成为可能。然而，当前的PINNs通常是针对单一物理任务进行训练的，即使是来自相似物理领域的任务，对于每个新任务也需要进行计算成本高昂的重新训练。为了解决这一限制，本文提出了一种开创性的方法，通过鲍德温进化（Baldwinian evolution）的框架来提升PINNs的泛化能力。受早熟物种（precocial species）神经发育的启发——这些物种已经进化到能够快速学习、预测和应对其环境——我们设想PINNs预先连接了连接强度，这些强度对高效学习物理学产生了强大的偏差。本文提出了一种新颖的两阶段随机规划公式来实例化鲍德温效应，该公式将进化选择压力（基于对物理任务分布的熟练程度）与终生学习（专注于这些任务的抽样子集）相结合。进化的Baldwinian-PINNs在一系列经验上具有挑战性的问题实例中展示了快速且符合物理学的预测能力，与最先进的基于梯度的元学习方法相比，其预测精度提高了十倍以上，而计算成本仅为其一小部分。例如，在求解扩散-反应方程时，精度提高了70倍，同时计算时间减少了700倍。因此，本文标志着PINNs作为可泛化物理求解器的元学习向前迈进了一大步。示例代码可在https://github.com/chiuph/Baldwinian-PINN获取。
tldr: 针对传统PINNs泛化性差的问题，本文提出了一种基于鲍德温效应（Baldwin Effect）的两阶段进化优化方法，通过预先设置连接强度（pre-wired biases）来加速学习，使得进化的PINNs（Baldwinian-PINNs）在计算成本大幅降低的同时，预测精度比现有元学习方法提高了十倍以上。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将生物进化中的鲍德温效应引入到科学机器学习的元学习框架中，用于优化PINNs的泛化能力。通过模拟“预先连接”的神经发育机制，该方法有效地实现了网络结构的内在偏差（intrinsic bias）优化，从而显著提高了PINNs在面对新任务时的学习速度和预测准确性。其重要性在于，它为创建高效、可泛化的物理求解器提供了新的范式，有望大幅降低科学仿真中模型适应新问题的计算成本。
motivation: 现有的物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通常只针对单一物理任务进行训练，对于新的类似任务需要进行计算成本高昂的重新训练，这限制了它们的泛化能力。
method: 提出了一种基于鲍德温进化框架的创新方法，通过实例化鲍德温效应来提高PINNs的泛化能力。具体实现是：采用一种新颖的两阶段随机规划公式，将进化选择压力（基于对物理任务分布的熟练程度）与终生学习（专注于任务的抽样子集）相结合。
results: 进化的Baldwinian-PINNs在各种具有挑战性的问题实例上展示了快速且符合物理学的预测能力。与最先进的基于梯度的元学习方法相比，其预测精度提高了十倍以上，而计算成本仅为其一小部分。例如，在求解扩散-反应方程时，精度提高了70倍，同时计算时间减少了700倍。
conclusion: 本文标志着PINNs作为可泛化物理求解器的元学习向前迈进了一大步。

title: Parameter Training Efficiency Aware Resource Allocation for AIGC in Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks
authors: Liangxin Qian, Peiyuan Si, Jun Zhao, Kwok-Yan Lam
abstract: With the evolution of artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) techniques and the development of space-air-ground integrated networks (SAGIN), there will be a growing opportunity to enhance more users' mobile experience with customized AIGC applications. This is made possible through the use of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) training alongside mobile edge computing. In this paper, we formulate the optimization problem of maximizing the parameter training efficiency of the SAGIN system over wireless networks under limited resource constraints. We propose the Parameter training efficiency Aware Resource Allocation (PARA) technique to jointly optimize user association, data offloading, and communication and computational resource allocation. Solid proofs are presented to solve this difficult sum of ratios problem based on quadratically constrained quadratic programming (QCQP), semidefinite programming (SDP), graph theory, and fractional programming (FP) techniques. Our proposed PARA technique is effective in finding a stationary point of this non-convex problem. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed PARA method outperforms other baselines.
comment: This paper was accepted by IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (TMC) on 27th December 2025
zh_title: 面向空天地一体化网络中AIGC的参数训练效率感知资源分配
translation: 随着人工智能生成内容（AIGC）技术的演进和空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）的发展，通过利用参数高效微调（PEFT）训练和移动边缘计算，增强更多用户移动体验的定制化AIGC应用的机会将不断增加。在本文中，我们提出了在有限资源约束下，最大化无线网络中SAGIN系统参数训练效率的优化问题。我们提出了参数训练效率感知资源分配（PARA）技术，以联合优化用户关联、数据卸载以及通信和计算资源分配。本文提出了可靠的证明来解决这一困难的“比率之和”问题，这些证明基于二次约束二次规划（QCQP）、半定规划（SDP）、图论和分式规划（FP）技术。我们提出的PARA技术在寻找这一非凸问题的稳定点方面是有效的。仿真结果表明，所提出的PARA方法优于其他基线方法。
tldr: 为提升空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）中定制化AIGC应用的移动体验，本文提出参数训练效率感知资源分配（PARA）技术，通过联合优化用户关联、数据卸载和资源分配，利用QCQP、SDP和FP等方法最大化系统参数训练效率，并在仿真中表现优于基线。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将参数训练效率（特别是针对AIGC和PEFT）作为核心优化目标，并将其融入到复杂的空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）资源分配框架中。这种结合反映了当前AI模型部署对网络资源提出的新要求。通过使用二次约束二次规划（QCQP）、半定规划（SDP）和分式规划（FP）等多种高级优化技术来解决非凸的“比率之和”问题，显示了研究人员在处理复杂系统优化方面的技术深度。该研究对于未来SAGIN支持大规模、定制化移动AI应用的实际部署具有重要意义。
motivation: 随着AIGC技术和空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）的发展，利用参数高效微调（PEFT）和移动边缘计算（MEC）来增强用户移动体验和定制化AIGC应用的机会日益增加。本文旨在解决在有限资源约束下，最大化SAGIN系统参数训练效率的优化问题。
method: 提出参数训练效率感知资源分配（PARA）技术。该方法旨在联合优化用户关联、数据卸载以及通信和计算资源分配。为解决这一困难的非凸“比率之和”问题，该技术利用了二次约束二次规划（QCQP）、半定规划（SDP）、图论和分式规划（FP）等技术，并提供了可靠的证明。
results: 提出的PARA技术能够有效地找到这一非凸问题的稳定点。仿真结果表明，所提出的PARA方法优于其他基线方法。

title: Test-time generative augmentation for medical image segmentation
authors: Xiao Ma, Yuhui Tao, Zetian Zhang, Yuhan Zhang, Xi Wang, Sheng Zhang, Zexuan Ji, Yizhe Zhang, Qiang Chen, Guang Yang
abstract: Medical image segmentation is critical for clinical diagnosis, treatment planning, and monitoring, yet segmentation models often struggle with uncertainties stemming from occlusions, ambiguous boundaries, and variations in imaging devices. Traditional test-time augmentation (TTA) techniques typically rely on predefined geometric and photometric transformations, limiting their adaptability and effectiveness in complex medical scenarios. In this study, we introduced Test-Time Generative Augmentation (TTGA), a novel augmentation strategy specifically tailored for medical image segmentation at inference time. Different from conventional augmentation strategies that suffer from excessive randomness or limited flexibility, TTGA leverages a domain-fine-tuned generative model to produce contextually relevant and diverse augmentations tailored to the characteristics of each test image. Built upon diffusion model inversion, a masked null-text inversion method is proposed to enable region-specific augmentations during sampling. Furthermore, a dual denoising pathway is designed to balance precise identity preservation with controlled variability. We demonstrate the efficacy of our TTGA through extensive experiments across three distinct segmentation tasks spanning nine datasets. Our results consistently demonstrate that TTGA not only improves segmentation accuracy (with DSC gains ranging from 0.1% to 2.3% over the baseline) but also offers pixel-wise error estimation (with DSC gains ranging from 1.1% to 29.0% over the baseline). The source code and demonstration are available at: https://github.com/maxiao0234/TTGA.
comment: Accepted for publication in Medical Image Analysis (MedIA). Finalized version. Vol. 109, March 2026
zh_title: 医用图像分割的测试时生成式增强
translation: 医用图像分割对于临床诊断、治疗计划和监测至关重要，但分割模型经常受到遮挡、模糊边界和成像设备差异带来的不确定性影响。传统的测试时增强（TTA）技术通常依赖预定义的几何和光度变换，限制了它们在复杂医疗场景中的适应性和有效性。在本研究中，我们引入了测试时生成式增强（TTGA），这是一种专门为推理时的医用图像分割量身定制的新型增强策略。与遭受过度随机性或有限灵活性的传统增强策略不同，TTGA利用领域微调的生成模型来生成针对每个测试图像特征的、上下文相关且多样化的增强。基于扩散模型反演，本文提出了一种掩码空文本反演方法，以在采样过程中实现区域特异性增强。此外，还设计了双重去噪路径，以平衡精确的身份保留和受控的变异性。我们通过对跨越九个数据集的三个不同分割任务的广泛实验证明了TTGA的有效性。我们的结果一致表明，TTGA不仅提高了分割精度（DSC增益比基线提高了0.1%至2.3%），而且提供了像素级误差估计（DSC增益比基线提高了1.1%至29.0%）。源代码和演示可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/maxiao0234/TTGA。
tldr: 针对医学图像分割中的不确定性问题，本文提出了测试时生成式增强（TTGA），它利用领域微调的生成模型（基于扩散模型反演和掩码空文本反演）生成上下文相关的多样化增强图像，显著提高了分割精度和像素级误差估计能力。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将生成模型（特别是基于扩散模型的反演技术）引入到测试时增强（TTA）领域，解决了传统TTA在医学图像分割中适应性差的问题。通过生成上下文相关、区域特异性的增强样本，TTGA能够更好地模拟真实世界的不确定性，从而提高模型的鲁棒性和精度。此外，其提供像素级误差估计的能力，对于临床应用中的不确定性量化具有重要价值。
motivation: 医用图像分割模型常受遮挡、模糊边界和成像设备差异带来的不确定性影响。传统的测试时增强（TTA）依赖预定义的几何和光度变换，缺乏适应性和灵活性。
method: 提出了一种新颖的测试时生成式增强（TTGA）策略。它利用领域微调的生成模型来生成上下文相关且多样化的增强。具体方法基于扩散模型反演，并提出了掩码空文本反演方法实现区域特异性增强，同时设计了双重去噪路径来平衡身份精确保持和可控变异性。
results: TTGA在跨越九个数据集的三个不同分割任务中得到验证。结果显示，TTGA不仅提高了分割精度（DSC增益比基线提高了0.1%至2.3%），而且提供了像素级误差估计（DSC增益比基线提高了1.1%至29.0%）。

title: Towards Knowledge Guided Pretraining Approaches for Multimodal Foundation Models: Applications in Remote Sensing
authors: Praveen Ravirathinam, Ajitesh Parthasarathy, Ankush Khandelwal, Rahul Ghosh, Vipin Kumar
abstract: Self-supervised learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for pretraining foundation models using large-scale data. Existing pretraining approaches predominantly rely on masked reconstruction or next-token prediction strategies, demonstrating strong performance across various downstream tasks, including geoscience applications. However, these approaches do not fully capture the knowledge of causal interplay between different geospatial and environmental variables. To address this limitation, we propose Knowledge Guided Variable-Step Forecasting (KG-VSF), a novel pretraining task that models forecasting as a conditional generation task, where driver variables (e.g., weather) inform the prediction of response variables (e.g., satellite imagery). We demonstrate that pretraining in such a fashion leads to strong embeddings which give enhanced performance when finetuned on downstream tasks where capturing this causality matters such as pixel wise crop type mapping, soil moisture estimation and forecasting, missing image prediction, and future image forecasting when compared to finetuning embeddings from other standard pretraining approaches.
zh_title: 面向知识引导的遥感多模态基础模型预训练方法：应用与实践
translation: 自监督学习已成为利用大规模数据预训练基础模型的一种强大范式。现有的预训练方法主要依赖于掩码重建或下一词元预测策略，在包括地球科学应用在内的各种下游任务中表现出强大的性能。然而，这些方法没有充分捕获不同地理空间和环境变量之间因果相互作用的知识。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的预训练任务——知识引导的可变步长预测（KG-VSF），它将预测建模为一个条件生成任务，其中驱动变量（例如天气）指导响应变量（例如卫星图像）的预测。我们证明，以这种方式进行预训练可以产生强大的嵌入，当在捕获因果关系至关重要的下游任务（如像素级作物类型测绘、土壤湿度估计和预测、缺失图像预测以及未来图像预测）上进行微调时，与微调来自其他标准预训练方法的嵌入相比，性能得到了增强。
tldr: 现有的遥感基础模型预训练方法（如掩码重建）未能充分捕获地理空间变量间的因果关系。我们提出了知识引导的可变步长预测（KG-VSF）这一新的预训练任务，将预测建模为条件生成，从而捕获驱动变量与响应变量之间的因果关系，在作物类型测绘、土壤湿度估计等下游任务中表现优于标准方法。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了KG-VSF预训练任务，明确将地理空间变量间的因果关系引入到多模态基础模型的预训练过程中，解决了现有自监督学习范式（如掩码重建）在捕捉复杂环境依赖性方面的不足。这对于提升遥感和地球科学领域中对时空变化和环境驱动因素理解至关重要的下游任务（如精准预测和监测）的性能具有重要意义，标志着遥感基础模型从纯数据驱动向知识和数据混合驱动迈出了重要一步。
motivation: 现有的自监督预训练方法主要依赖于掩码重建或下一词元预测，未能充分捕获不同地理空间和环境变量之间的因果相互作用知识。
method: 提出“知识引导的可变步长预测”（KG-VSF）这一新的预训练任务。该方法将预测建模为一个条件生成任务，利用驱动变量（例如天气）来指导响应变量（例如卫星图像）的预测。
results: 通过KG-VSF预训练获得的嵌入（embeddings）具有更强的性能。在需要捕获因果关系的关键下游任务（如像素级作物类型测绘、土壤湿度估计和预测、缺失图像预测和未来图像预测）上进行微调时，其性能优于其他标准预训练方法的嵌入。
conclusion: 知识引导的可变步长预测（KG-VSF）预训练方法能够有效地将因果知识整合到基础模型中，解决了现有方法的局限性，并在多种遥感应用中实现了性能提升。

title: EXAONE 3.0 7.8B Instruction Tuned Language Model
authors: Soyoung An, Kyunghoon Bae, Eunbi Choi, Stanley Jungkyu Choi, Yemuk Choi, Seokhee Hong, Yeonjung Hong, Junwon Hwang, Hyojin Jeon, Gerrard Jeongwon Jo, Hyunjik Jo, Jiyeon Jung, Yountae Jung, Euisoon Kim, Hyosang Kim, Joonkee Kim, Seonghwan Kim, Soyeon Kim, Sunkyoung Kim, Yireun Kim, Youchul Kim, Edward Hwayoung Lee, Haeju Lee, Honglak Lee, Jinsik Lee, Kyungmin Lee, Moontae Lee, Seungjun Lee, Woohyung Lim, Sangha Park, Sooyoun Park, Yongmin Park, Boseong Seo, Sihoon Yang, Heuiyeen Yeen, Kyungjae Yoo, Hyeongu Yun
abstract: We introduce EXAONE 3.0 instruction-tuned language model, the first open model in the family of Large Language Models (LLMs) developed by LG AI Research. Among different model sizes, we publicly release the 7.8B instruction-tuned model to promote open research and innovations. Through extensive evaluations across a wide range of public and in-house benchmarks, EXAONE 3.0 demonstrates highly competitive real-world performance with instruction-following capability against other state-of-the-art open models of similar size. Our comparative analysis shows that EXAONE 3.0 excels particularly in Korean, while achieving compelling performance across general tasks and complex reasoning. With its strong real-world effectiveness and bilingual proficiency, we hope that EXAONE keeps contributing to advancements in Expert AI. Our EXAONE 3.0 instruction-tuned model is available at https://huggingface.co/LGAI-EXAONE/EXAONE-3.0-7.8B-Instruct.
zh_title: EXAONE 3.0 7.8B 指令微调语言模型
translation: 我们介绍了 EXAONE 3.0 指令微调语言模型，这是 LG AI Research 开发的大型语言模型（LLMs）系列中的第一个开放模型。在不同模型尺寸中，我们公开发布了 7.8B 指令微调模型，以促进开放研究和创新。通过对广泛的公共和内部基准进行全面评估，EXAONE 3.0 在指令遵循能力方面展示了与同尺寸其他最先进开源模型相比具有高度竞争力的真实世界性能。我们的比较分析显示，EXAONE 3.0 在韩语方面表现尤为突出，同时在通用任务和复杂推理方面也取得了引人注目的性能。凭借其强大的真实世界有效性和双语能力，我们希望 EXAONE 能够持续为专家AI的进步做出贡献。我们的 EXAONE 3.0 指令微调模型可在 https://huggingface.co/LGAI-EXAONE/EXAONE-3.0-7.8B-Instruct 获取。
tldr: LG AI Research 发布了 EXAONE 3.0 的 7.8B 指令微调版本，这是其首个开源大模型，在韩语和通用任务上表现出色，性能与同尺寸的先进开源模型相当。
ai_comments: 该工作的创新点在于它是 LG AI Research 首次将大型语言模型家族（EXAONE 3.0）的特定版本（7.8B）开源，这对于促进韩国语种的LLM研究具有重要意义。该模型强调其在韩语方面的卓越性能，填补了特定语言模型的空白。其重要性在于，它为研究人员提供了一个经过指令微调、具有强大竞争力的中等规模模型，尤其是在双语（特别是韩语）环境下的应用。局限性（未在摘要中明确提及）：作为一个7.8B的模型，其在处理需要极大上下文或知识的任务上，可能仍不如更大的闭源模型。
motivation: 促进开放研究和创新，并希望该模型能为专家AI的进步做出贡献。
method: 开发并公开发布了一个经过指令微调的7.8B大型语言模型（LLM）。通过对广泛的公共和内部基准进行评估，验证其指令遵循能力和真实世界性能。
results: EXAONE 3.0 在指令遵循能力方面展示出与同尺寸最先进开源模型高度竞争的真实世界性能。它在韩语方面表现尤为出色，同时在通用任务和复杂推理方面也取得了引人注目的性能。
conclusion: 该模型具有强大的真实世界有效性和双语能力（尤其擅长韩语），有望持续推动专家AI（Expert AI）的进步。

title: LeanQuant: Accurate and Scalable Large Language Model Quantization with Loss-error-aware Grid
authors: Tianyi Zhang, Anshumali Shrivastava
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown immense potential across various domains, but their high memory requirements and inference costs remain critical challenges for deployment. Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a promising technique to reduce memory requirements and decoding latency. However, recent accurate quantization methods often depend on specialized computations or custom data formats to achieve better model quality, which limits their compatibility with popular frameworks, as they require dedicated inference kernels tailored to specific hardware and software platforms, hindering wider adoption. Furthermore, many competitive methods have high resource requirements and computational overhead for quantizing models, making it challenging to scale them to hundreds of billions of parameters. In response to these challenges, we propose LeanQuant (Loss-Error-Aware Network Quantization), a novel quantization method that is accurate, versatile, and scalable. In the existing popular iterative loss-error-based quantization framework, we identify a critical limitation in prior methods: the min-max affine quantization grid fails to preserve model quality due to outliers in inverse Hessian diagonals. To overcome this fundamental issue, we propose learning loss-error-aware grids, instead of using non-adaptive min-max affine grids. Our approach not only produces quantized models that are more accurate but also generalizes to a wider range of quantization types, including affine and non-uniform quantization, enhancing compatibility with more frameworks. Extensive experiments with recent LLMs demonstrate that LeanQuant is highly accurate, comparing favorably against competitive baselines in model quality, and scalable, achieving very accurate quantization of Llama-3.1 405B, one of the largest open-source LLMs to date, using two Quadro RTX 8000-48GB GPUs in 21 hours.
zh_title: LeanQuant：基于损失误差感知网格的准确且可扩展的大语言模型量化
translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在各个领域展现出巨大的潜力，但其高内存需求和推理成本仍然是部署的关键挑战。后训练量化（PTQ）已成为一种有前景的技术，用于减少内存需求和解码延迟。然而，最近准确的量化方法通常依赖于专用计算或自定义数据格式来实现更好的模型质量，这限制了它们与流行框架的兼容性，因为它们需要针对特定硬件和软件平台定制的推理内核，阻碍了更广泛的应用。此外，许多有竞争力的量化方法在量化模型时具有高资源需求和计算开销，使得它们难以扩展到数百亿参数。针对这些挑战，我们提出了LeanQuant（损失误差感知网络量化），这是一种新颖的、准确、通用且可扩展的量化方法。在现有的流行的基于迭代损失误差的量化框架中，我们发现现有方法的一个关键局限性：由于逆Hessian对角线中的异常值，min-max仿射量化网格未能保持模型质量。为了克服这一根本问题，我们建议学习损失误差感知网格，而不是使用非自适应的min-max仿射网格。我们的方法不仅生成的量化模型更准确，而且还可以推广到更广泛的量化类型，包括仿射和非均匀量化，从而增强了与更多框架的兼容性。对最新LLMs进行的广泛实验表明，LeanQuant具有高度准确性，在模型质量上优于有竞争力的基线，并且具有可扩展性，使用两块Quadro RTX 8000-48GB GPU在21小时内实现了Llama-3.1 405B（迄今为止最大的开源LLM之一）的非常准确的量化。
tldr: LeanQuant是一种用于大语言模型的准确且可扩展的后训练量化（PTQ）方法。它用损失误差感知网格取代了有缺陷的min-max网格，显著提高了量化精度和框架兼容性，并成功在21小时内量化了Llama-3.1 405B。
ai_comments: LeanQuant的主要创新在于在现有的迭代损失误差量化框架中，用学习到的“损失误差感知网格”取代了非自适应的min-max仿射网格，从而解决了逆Hessian对角线中异常值导致的模型质量下降问题。这一改进提高了量化精度和泛化能力。该研究的重要性在于同时解决了LLM量化部署中的两大关键挑战：兼容性（通过支持更广泛的量化类型，避免专用内核）和可扩展性（成功高效地量化了405B规模的模型）。这一方法的通用性和可扩展性对于推动LLM的广泛、低成本部署至关重要。
motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）的内存需求和推理成本高昂。现有的准确量化方法依赖专用计算或自定义数据格式，限制了与流行框架的兼容性。此外，许多有竞争力的量化方法资源需求和计算开销高，难以扩展到数百亿参数的模型。在现有的迭代损失误差量化框架中，min-max仿射量化网格由于逆Hessian对角线中的异常值而无法保持模型质量。
method: 提出LeanQuant（损失误差感知网络量化）方法。该方法的核心是通过学习“损失误差感知网格”，取代在现有迭代损失误差量化框架中失效的非自适应min-max仿射网格。
results: LeanQuant生成的量化模型更准确，并可推广到更广泛的量化类型（包括仿射和非均匀量化），增强了兼容性。实验证明，LeanQuant与有竞争力的基线相比，在模型质量上表现优异，并且具有可扩展性，使用两块Quadro RTX 8000-48GB GPU在21小时内完成了Llama-3.1 405B的准确量化。
conclusion: LeanQuant是一种准确、通用且可扩展的量化方法。通过引入损失误差感知网格，它克服了现有方法中min-max网格的局限性，提高了量化精度和框架兼容性，并成功应用于超大规模模型。

title: Sorbet: A Neuromorphic Hardware-Compatible Transformer-Based Spiking Language Model
authors: Kaiwen Tang, Zhanglu Yan, Weng-Fai Wong
abstract: For reasons such as privacy, there are use cases for language models at the edge. This has given rise to small language models targeted for deployment in resource-constrained devices where energy efficiency is critical. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer a promising solution due to their energy efficiency, and there are already works on realizing transformer-based models on SNNs. However, key operations like softmax and layer normalization (LN) are difficult to implement on neuromorphic hardware, and many of these early works sidestepped them. To address these challenges, we introduce Sorbet, a transformer-based spiking language model that is more neuromorphic hardware-compatible. Sorbet incorporates a novel shifting-based softmax called PTsoftmax and a Bit Shifting PowerNorm (BSPN), both designed to replace the respective energy-intensive operations. By leveraging knowledge distillation and model quantization, Sorbet achieved a highly compressed binary weight model that maintains competitive performance while achieving $27.16\times$ energy savings compared to BERT. We validate Sorbet through extensive testing on the GLUE benchmark and a series of ablation studies, demonstrating its potential as an energy-efficient solution for language model inference. Our code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/Kaiwen-Tang/Sorbet}{https://github.com/Kaiwen-Tang/Sorbet}
zh_title: Sorbet：一种神经拟态硬件兼容的基于Transformer的脉冲语言模型
translation: 出于隐私等原因，语言模型存在边缘部署的使用场景。这催生了针对资源受限设备的小型语言模型，其中能效至关重要。脉冲神经网络（SNNs）因其能效而提供了一个有前景的解决方案，并且已经有一些关于在SNN上实现基于Transformer模型的现有工作。然而，像softmax和层归一化（LN）这样的关键操作难以在神经拟态硬件上实现，许多早期的工作都规避了它们。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了Sorbet，这是一种基于Transformer的脉冲语言模型，它更兼容神经拟态硬件。Sorbet包含一种名为PTsoftmax的新型基于移位的softmax和一种位移幂归一化（BSPN），两者都旨在替代相应的高能耗操作。通过利用知识蒸馏和模型量化，Sorbet实现了高度压缩的二值权重模型，该模型在保持竞争性能的同时，与BERT相比实现了$27.16\times$的能耗节省。我们通过在GLUE基准测试上的广泛测试和一系列消融研究验证了Sorbet，证明了其作为语言模型推理的节能解决方案的潜力。我们的代码已在[链接]上公开。
tldr: 提出Sorbet，一个基于SNN的Transformer语言模型，它使用新的移位操作（PTsoftmax和BSPN）替换了难以实现的softmax和层归一化，实现了神经拟态硬件兼容性，并在保持性能的同时比BERT节省了27.16倍的能耗。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一种面向神经拟态硬件优化的Transformer模型Sorbet。它通过设计新颖的、基于移位的操作（PTsoftmax和BSPN）来替代传统SNN中难以实现且高能耗的softmax和层归一化操作，显著提升了模型的硬件兼容性和能效。高达27.16倍于BERT的能耗节省证明了其在边缘设备部署小型语言模型方面的巨大潜力，为在资源受限环境中实现先进的自然语言处理功能提供了可行的方向。
motivation: 出于隐私等原因，需要在边缘设备上部署语言模型。这催生了对资源受限设备上高能效小型语言模型的需求。虽然脉冲神经网络（SNNs）很有潜力，但关键操作（如softmax和层归一化）难以在神经拟态硬件上实现，因此需要设计更具兼容性的模型。
method: 引入了基于Transformer的脉冲语言模型Sorbet。该模型集成了新型的基于移位的softmax（PTsoftmax）和位移幂归一化（BSPN），用以替代高能耗操作。通过利用知识蒸馏和模型量化技术，实现了高度压缩的二值权重模型。
results: 实现了高度压缩的二值权重模型，同时保持了有竞争力的性能。与BERT相比，实现了$27.16\times$的能耗节省。通过GLUE基准测试和一系列消融研究进行了验证。
conclusion: 证明了Sorbet作为语言模型推理的节能解决方案的潜力。

title: Inner-Probe: Discovering Copyright-related Data Generation in LLM Architecture
authors: Qichao Ma, Rui-Jie Zhu, Peiye Liu, Renye Yan, Fahong Zhang, Ling Liang, Meng Li, Zhaofei Yu, Zongwei Wang, Yimao Cai, Tiejun Huang
abstract:
Large Language Models (LLMs) utilize extensive knowledge databases and show powerful text generation ability. However, their reliance on high-quality copyrighted datasets raises concerns about copyright infringements in generated texts. Current research often employs prompt engineering or semantic classifiers to identify copyrighted content, but these approaches have two significant limitations: (1) Challenging to identify which specific subdataset (e.g., works from particular authors) influences an LLM's output. (2) Treating the entire training database as copyrighted, hence overlooking the inclusion of non-copyrighted training data.
  We propose Inner-Probe, a lightweight framework designed to evaluate the influence of copyrighted sub-datasets on LLM-generated texts. Unlike traditional methods relying solely on text, we discover that the results of multi-head attention (MHA) during LLM output generation provide more effective information. Thus, Inner-Probe performs sub-dataset contribution analysis using a lightweight LSTM based network trained on MHA results in a supervised manner. Harnessing such a prior, Inner-Probe enables non-copyrighted text detection through a concatenated global projector trained with unsupervised contrastive learning. Inner-Probe demonstrates 3x improved efficiency compared to semantic model training in sub-dataset contribution analysis on Books3, achieves 15.04% - 58.7% higher accuracy over baselines on the Pile, and delivers a 0.104 increase in AUC for non-copyrighted data filtering.
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence
zh_title: Inner-Probe：发现LLM架构中与版权相关的数据生成
translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）利用了广泛的知识库并展现出强大的文本生成能力。然而，它们对高质量版权数据集的依赖引发了对生成文本中版权侵权的担忧。当前研究通常采用提示工程或语义分类器来识别受版权保护的内容，但这些方法存在两个重大局限性：（1）难以识别具体哪个子数据集（例如，特定作者的作品）影响了LLM的输出。（2）将整个训练数据库视为受版权保护，从而忽略了非版权训练数据的存在。我们提出了Inner-Probe，这是一个轻量级框架，旨在评估受版权保护的子数据集对LLM生成文本的影响。与仅依赖文本的传统方法不同，我们发现LLM输出生成过程中多头注意力（MHA）的结果提供了更有效的信息。因此，Inner-Probe使用一个基于MHA结果、以监督方式训练的轻量级LSTM网络进行子数据集贡献分析。利用这一先验知识，Inner-Probe通过一个使用无监督对比学习训练的串联全局投影器实现非版权文本检测。Inner-Probe在Books3上的子数据集贡献分析效率比语义模型训练提高了3倍，在Pile数据集上比基线准确率提高了15.04%至58.7%，并且在非版权数据过滤方面AUC提高了0.104。
tldr: 针对LLM的版权侵权问题，本文提出了Inner-Probe框架。它通过分析模型内部的多头注意力（MHA）结果，使用轻量级LSTM和对比学习，高效准确地识别特定受版权保护的子数据集对生成文本的影响，并过滤非版权数据。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将版权侵权检测的焦点从外部文本分析（如提示工程或语义分类器）转移到LLM架构内部的信号。通过利用多头注意力（MHA）的结果作为评估特定训练子数据集贡献的有效信息源，Inner-Probe提供了一种比传统基于文本方法更精细、更高效的归因方法。这对于解决LLM训练数据的版权溯源和合规性问题具有重要的实际意义。
motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）对高质量版权数据集的依赖引发了生成文本中的版权侵权担忧。现有方法难以识别具体受影响的子数据集，并且忽略了训练数据中非版权内容的存在。
method: 提出轻量级框架Inner-Probe。它利用LLM输出生成过程中多头注意力（MHA）的结果（而非仅文本）进行分析。通过一个基于MHA结果训练的轻量级LSTM网络进行受版权保护子数据集的贡献分析（监督学习）。在此基础上，利用无监督对比学习训练的串联全局投影器实现非版权文本检测。
results: 在Books3上的子数据集贡献分析效率比语义模型训练提高了3倍。在Pile数据集上，准确率比基线提高了15.04%至58.7%。在非版权数据过滤方面，AUC提高了0.104。
conclusion: Inner-Probe通过利用LLM内部的多头注意力（MHA）信息，提供了一种比传统基于文本方法更高效、更准确的方式来评估受版权保护的子数据集对生成文本的影响，并成功实现非版权数据的过滤。

title: EXAONE 3.5: Series of Large Language Models for Real-world Use Cases
authors: Soyoung An, Kyunghoon Bae, Eunbi Choi, Kibong Choi, Stanley Jungkyu Choi, Seokhee Hong, Junwon Hwang, Hyojin Jeon, Gerrard Jeongwon Jo, Hyunjik Jo, Jiyeon Jung, Yountae Jung, Hyosang Kim, Joonkee Kim, Seonghwan Kim, Soyeon Kim, Sunkyoung Kim, Yireun Kim, Yongil Kim, Youchul Kim, Edward Hwayoung Lee, Haeju Lee, Honglak Lee, Jinsik Lee, Kyungmin Lee, Woohyung Lim, Sangha Park, Sooyoun Park, Yongmin Park, Sihoon Yang, Heuiyeen Yeen, Hyeongu Yun
abstract: This technical report introduces the EXAONE 3.5 instruction-tuned language models, developed and released by LG AI Research. The EXAONE 3.5 language models are offered in three configurations: 32B, 7.8B, and 2.4B. These models feature several standout capabilities: 1) exceptional instruction following capabilities in real-world scenarios, achieving the highest scores across seven benchmarks, 2) outstanding long-context comprehension, attaining the top performance in four benchmarks, and 3) competitive results compared to state-of-the-art open models of similar sizes across nine general benchmarks. The EXAONE 3.5 language models are open to anyone for research purposes and can be downloaded from https://huggingface.co/LGAI-EXAONE. For commercial use, please reach out to the official contact point of LG AI Research: contact_us@lgresearch.ai.
zh_title: EXAONE 3.5：面向真实世界用例的大型语言模型系列
translation: 本技术报告介绍了由 LG AI Research 开发和发布的 EXAONE 3.5 指令微调语言模型。EXAONE 3.5 语言模型提供三种配置：32B、7.8B 和 2.4B。这些模型具有几项突出的能力：1) 在真实世界场景中具有卓越的指令遵循能力，在七个基准测试中取得最高分；2) 杰出的长上下文理解能力，在四个基准测试中达到最佳性能；3) 在九个通用基准测试中，与同尺寸的现有最佳开源模型相比，具有竞争力的结果。EXAONE 3.5 语言模型向所有人开放用于研究目的，可从 https://huggingface.co/LGAI-EXAONE 下载。如需商业用途，请联系 LG AI Research 的官方联系点：contact_us@lgresearch.ai。
tldr: LG AI Research 发布了 EXAONE 3.5 系列指令微调大模型（32B, 7.8B, 2.4B），该模型在真实世界指令遵循和长上下文理解方面表现卓越，并已开放研究用途下载。
ai_comments: EXAONE 3.5 系列模型的创新点在于其明确针对“真实世界用例”进行了指令微调，并声称在多个关键性能指标上（如指令遵循和长上下文理解）超越了同类模型。这种多尺寸（32B、7.8B、2.4B）的发布策略，为研究人员和企业在不同计算资源和部署场景下提供了灵活的选择。模型的开放性（供研究用途）对于推动开源社区在实用型、高性能LLM领域的发展具有重要意义。然而，作为技术报告摘要，它缺乏关于具体训练数据、指令微调过程或基准测试细节的深入信息，这些细节对于评估其宣称的“最高分”至关重要。
motivation: 开发并发布一系列专注于真实世界用例、具有卓越指令遵循和长上下文理解能力的指令微调大型语言模型。
method: 该方法是开发一系列经过指令微调（instruction-tuned）的大型语言模型。具体的技术细节（如模型架构或训练数据）在摘要中未提及。
results: 1. 在七个真实世界场景指令遵循基准测试中取得了最高分。2. 在四个长上下文理解基准测试中取得了最佳性能。3. 在九个通用基准测试中，与同尺寸的现有最佳开源模型相比，取得了具有竞争力的结果。
conclusion: EXAONE 3.5 是一系列由 LG AI Research 开发并发布的指令微调大型语言模型，包含 32B、7.8B 和 2.4B 三种配置。该系列模型在真实世界指令遵循和长上下文理解方面表现卓越，并在通用基准测试中具有竞争力，目前已开放供研究使用。

title: Dual-Scale Channel Estimation in Sensing-Assisted Communication Systems: Joint Time Allocation and Beamforming Design
authors: Bai Zhiyue, Dai Minghui, Hou Fen, Shan hangguan, Cai X Lin, Shen, Xuemin
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel integrated sensing and communication (ISAC)-enabled dual-scale channel estimation framework, where large-scale channel estimation benefits from sensing, and the temporal variation of small-scale channel state information is modeled via channel aging. By characterizing the impact of angular sensing error on the communication spatial correlation matrix, we derive a closed form expression for the achievable rate under dual-scale channel estimation errors. Considering the different characteristics in time scales, we design the sensing duration for slow-varying large-scale channel and determine the update timing and frequency for fast-varying small-scale channel information within a given frame structure. We formulate an average achievable rate maximization problem under limited time resources and sensing Cramer-Rao bound (CRB) constraints, and propose a segmented golden based joint optimization algorithm to efficiently solve this nonconvex problem. Simulation results demonstrate that our proposed scheme achieves significant performance improvement compared with the benchmark schemes, which further validate that the system can leverage additional sensing capabilities to enhance communication efficiency.
zh_title: 感知辅助通信系统中的双尺度信道估计：联合时间分配与波束成形设计
translation: 在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的集成感知与通信（ISAC）驱动的双尺度信道估计框架，其中大尺度信道估计受益于感知，小尺度信道状态信息的时间变化通过信道老化进行建模。通过表征角度感知误差对通信空间相关矩阵的影响，我们推导了双尺度信道估计误差下的可达速率闭式表达式。考虑到时间尺度的不同特性，我们在给定的帧结构内设计了慢变大尺度信道的感知时长，并确定了快变小尺度信道信息的更新时机和频率。我们制定了一个在有限时间资源和感知克拉美罗下界（CRB）约束下的平均可达速率最大化问题，并提出了一种分段黄金搜索联合优化算法来有效求解这个非凸问题。仿真结果表明，与基准方案相比，我们提出的方案取得了显著的性能提升，这进一步验证了系统可以利用额外的感知能力来提高通信效率。
tldr: 本文提出了一个集成感知与通信（ISAC）的双尺度信道估计框架。通过建模信道老化和感知误差的影响，我们推导了可达速率。然后，我们联合优化了慢变大尺度信道的感知时长和快变小尺度信道的更新频率，以最大化平均可达速率，并通过仿真证明了其优越性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个统一的ISAC框架来解决双尺度信道估计问题，并明确地将角度感知误差的影响纳入通信空间相关矩阵的建模中。通过区分慢变大尺度信道（分配感知时长）和快变小尺度信道（确定更新频率），实现了对有限时间资源的精细化管理。所提出的联合优化设计和高效的求解算法（分段黄金搜索）对于在实际ISAC系统中平衡感知精度和通信效率具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 旨在解决集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统中双尺度信道估计的问题，其中大尺度信道估计受益于感知，而小尺度信道信息的时间变化通过信道老化建模。此外，还需要在有限的时间资源下最大化系统的平均可达速率。
method: 提出了一个ISAC驱动的双尺度信道估计框架。通过表征角度感知误差对通信空间相关矩阵的影响，推导了双尺度信道估计误差下的可达速率闭式表达式。然后，将平均可达速率最大化问题建模为受限于有限时间和感知CRB的非凸问题，并提出了一种分段黄金搜索联合优化算法进行求解。
results: 仿真结果表明，所提出的方案比基准方案实现了显著的性能提升，进一步验证了系统可以利用额外的感知能力来提高通信效率。
conclusion: 本文提出的联合时间分配和波束成形方案，通过利用感知能力辅助大尺度信道估计，显著提高了系统性能和通信效率。

title: Semantic Anchor Transport: Robust Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language Models
authors: Shambhavi Mishra, Julio Silva-Rodriguez, Ismail Ben Ayed, Marco Pedersoli, Jose Dolz
abstract: Large pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, have shown unprecedented zero-shot performance across a wide range of tasks. Nevertheless, these models may be unreliable under distributional shifts, as their performance is significantly degraded. In this work, we investigate how to efficiently utilize class text information to mitigate distribution drifts encountered by VLMs during inference. In particular, we propose generating pseudo-labels for the noisy test-time samples by aligning visual embeddings with reliable, text-based semantic anchors. Specifically, to maintain the regular structure of the dataset properly, we formulate the problem as a batch-wise label assignment, which is efficiently solved using Optimal Transport. Our method, Semantic Anchor Transport (SAT), utilizes such pseudo-labels as supervisory signals for test-time adaptation, yielding a principled cross-modal alignment solution. Moreover, SAT further leverages heterogeneous textual clues, with a multi-template distillation approach that replicates multi-view contrastive learning strategies in unsupervised representation learning without incurring additional computational complexity. Extensive experiments on multiple popular test-time adaptation benchmarks presenting diverse complexity empirically show the superiority of SAT, achieving consistent performance gains over recent state-of-the-art methods, yet being computationally efficient.
comment: Added additional figures to communicate the algorithm
zh_title: 语义锚点传输：面向视觉-语言模型的鲁棒测试时适应
translation: 大规模预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM），如CLIP，在广泛的任务中展现了前所未有的零样本性能。然而，这些模型在分布偏移下可能不可靠，因为它们的性能会显著下降。在这项工作中，我们研究了如何有效地利用类别文本信息来缓解VLM在推理过程中遇到的分布漂移。具体而言，我们提出通过将视觉嵌入与可靠的、基于文本的语义锚点对齐，为带噪声的测试时样本生成伪标签。特别是，为了正确维护数据集的规则结构，我们将该问题公式化为批次的标签分配，并使用最优传输（Optimal Transport）高效求解。我们的方法，语义锚点传输（SAT），利用这些伪标签作为测试时适应的监督信号，从而产生了一个原则性的跨模态对齐解决方案。此外，SAT进一步利用异构的文本线索，采用多模板蒸馏方法，在不增加额外计算复杂性的情况下，复制了无监督表示学习中的多视角对比学习策略。在多个流行的、具有不同复杂度的测试时适应基准上进行的广泛实验经验性地证明了SAT的优越性，实现了对现有最新SOTA方法的持续性能提升，且具有计算效率。
tldr: 大型视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）在数据分布偏移下性能下降。本文提出“语义锚点传输”（SAT），利用可靠的文本语义锚点和最优传输（Optimal Transport）生成伪标签，实现高效且鲁棒的测试时适应。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将可靠的文本语义信息（语义锚点）与最优传输（Optimal Transport, OT）相结合，用于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的鲁棒测试时适应（TTA）。利用OT来解决批次标签分配问题，有效地确保了伪标签的结构规律性，提高了适应的稳定性。此外，多模板蒸馏策略能够高效地利用异构文本线索，进一步提升了模型的性能，同时保持了计算效率。
motivation: 解决大型预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）在推理过程中遇到分布偏移时性能显著下降的问题，并研究如何高效利用类别文本信息来缓解这种偏移。
method: 提出语义锚点传输（SAT）方法。通过将视觉嵌入与可靠的、基于文本的语义锚点对齐，为带噪声的测试样本生成伪标签。将该问题公式化为批次的标签分配问题，并使用最优传输（Optimal Transport）高效求解。SAT利用这些伪标签作为监督信号进行测试时适应。此外，通过多模板蒸馏方法利用异构文本线索，模仿无监督表示学习中的多视角对比学习策略。
results: 在多个流行的、具有不同复杂度的测试时适应基准上进行了广泛实验，经验性地证明了SAT的优越性，实现了对现有SOTA方法持续的性能提升，且具有计算效率。

title: Sketch to Adapt: Fine-Tunable Sketches for Efficient LLM Adaptation
authors: Tianyi Zhang, Junda Su, Aditya Desai, Oscar Wu, Zhaozhuo Xu, Anshumali Shrivastava
abstract: Adapting pre-trained large language models (LLMs) is crucial but challenging due to their enormous size. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques typically employ additive adapters applied to frozen model weights. To further reduce memory usage, model weights are often compressed through quantization. However, existing PEFT methods often yield suboptimal model quality because they rely on restrictive assumptions, such as low-rank constraints on adapters to limit the number of trainable parameters. We find that sketching, a popular data compression technique, can serve as an efficient LLM adaptation strategy while avoiding the low-rank assumption. We introduce SketchTune, a compressive adaptation strategy that compresses LLM weights into compact fine-tunable sketches, integrating compression and adaptation into a unified framework. This integration eliminates the need for complex two-path computation in existing PEFT techniques, enabling faster and more memory-efficient training and inference. SketchTune is supported by mathematical insights into matrix classes that are better approximated using sketching rather than low-rank methods. Our extensive evaluations with Llama and Mistral models demonstrate that SketchTune outperforms leading PEFT methods across diverse tasks while using substantially smaller base models and comparable trainable parameters. As a highlight, SketchTune outperforms LoRA, DoRA, and S2FT on commonsense and math benchmarks using 2.6-3.5$\times$ smaller base models and exceeds LoftQ in accuracy by 14.48% on GSM8K with 7.3$\times$ fewer trainable parameters. Our code is available at https://github.com/LeanModels/SketchTune.
zh_title: 素描式适应：用于高效LLM适应的可微调素描
translation: 适应预训练的大型语言模型（LLMs）至关重要，但由于其庞大的规模而充满挑战。参数高效微调（PEFT）技术通常采用应用于冻结模型权重的附加适配器。为了进一步减少内存使用，模型权重通常通过量化进行压缩。然而，现有的PEFT方法通常会产生次优的模型质量，因为它们依赖于限制性假设，例如对适配器施加低秩约束以限制可训练参数的数量。我们发现，素描（sketching）——一种流行的数据压缩技术——可以作为一种高效的LLM适应策略，同时避免低秩假设。我们引入了SketchTune，这是一种将LLM权重压缩成紧凑、可微调素描的压缩适应策略，将压缩和适应整合到一个统一的框架中。这种整合消除了现有PEFT技术中复杂的双路径计算需求，从而实现了更快、更节省内存的训练和推理。SketchTune得到了数学洞察的支持，这些洞察表明特定的矩阵类别更适合使用素描而不是低秩方法来近似。我们对Llama和Mistral模型进行的广泛评估表明，SketchTune在各种任务上均优于领先的PEFT方法，同时使用明显更小的基础模型和相当的可训练参数。值得强调的是，SketchTune在使用小2.6-3.5倍的基础模型时，在常识和数学基准测试中优于LoRA、DoRA和S2FT，并且在GSM8K上，训练参数少7.3倍的情况下，准确率比LoftQ高出14.48%。我们的代码可在https://github.com/LeanModels/SketchTune获取。
tldr: 我们提出了SketchTune，一种使用数据压缩（素描）进行LLM适应的新策略。它将模型权重压缩成可微调的素描，避免了低秩约束，实现了更快的训练和推理，并且在更小的基础模型上，性能显著优于现有的PEFT方法（如LoRA）。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于用直接应用于权重的压缩素描技术取代了PEFT中标准的附加适配器/低秩约束方法。这解决了核心限制（低秩假设导致的次优质量），同时通过统一框架提高了效率。该方法能够在基础模型小得多的情况下保持优异性能，这对实际部署具有重大的实用价值。
motivation: 预训练的大型语言模型（LLMs）由于体积庞大，其适应过程具有挑战性。现有的参数高效微调（PEFT）技术（如依赖低秩约束的适配器）通常基于限制性假设，导致模型质量不理想。
method: 提出SketchTune，一种压缩适应策略。它将LLM权重压缩成紧凑的、可微调的素描（sketches），将压缩与适应整合到统一框架中。这种方法避免了现有PEFT技术中复杂的双路径计算，并利用数学洞察力支持素描比低秩方法更好地近似特定矩阵类别。
results: SketchTune在各种任务上优于领先的PEFT方法（如LoRA, DoRA, S2FT, LoftQ），同时使用明显更小的基础模型和相当或更少的训练参数。例如，使用比LoRA/DoRA/S2FT小2.6-3.5倍的基础模型，并在GSM8K上比LoftQ的准确率高14.48%，而训练参数少7.3倍。
conclusion: SketchTune是一种高效的LLM适应策略，它通过使用可微调的素描来整合压缩和适应，从而避免了现有PEFT方法的低秩约束限制，并在性能和效率上超越了它们。

title: Constant Inapproximability of Pacing Equilibria in Second-Price Auctions
authors: Xi Chen, Yuhao Li
abstract: In this paper, we revisit the problem of approximating a pacing equilibrium in second-price auctions, introduced by Conitzer, Kroer, Sodomka, and Moses [Oper. Res. 2022]. We show that finding a constant-factor approximation of a pacing equilibrium is PPAD-hard, thereby strengthening previous results of Chen, Kroer, and Kumar [Math. Oper. Res. 2024], which established PPAD-hardness only for inverse-polynomial approximations.
zh_title: 第二价格拍卖中步速均衡的常数不可近似性
translation: 在本文中，我们重新审视了Conitzer, Kroer, Sodomka, 和 Moses [Oper. Res. 2022] 提出的在第二价格拍卖中近似步速均衡的问题。我们证明了找到步速均衡的常数因子近似是PPAD-难的，从而强化了Chen, Kroer, 和 Kumar [Math. Oper. Res. 2024] 先前的结果，他们只建立了逆多项式近似的PPAD-难度。
tldr: 在第二价格拍卖中，找到步速均衡的常数因子近似被证明是PPAD-难的，这比现有结果（逆多项式近似）更强。
ai_comments: 本文在计算复杂性理论方面做出了重要贡献，它将第二价格拍卖中步速均衡的近似难度从逆多项式近似提升到了常数因子近似的PPAD-难。这一强化结果显著收紧了该问题的计算界限，表明即使是要求相对宽松的常数近似解，也极有可能无法在多项式时间内找到（除非PPAD⊆P），这对理解和设计实际应用中的拍卖机制具有重要的理论指导意义。
motivation: 重新审视并研究第二价格拍卖中步速均衡的近似问题，该问题此前由Conitzer, Kroer, Sodomka, 和 Moses提出。
method: 通过复杂度理论证明（具体证明细节未提及），证明了寻找步速均衡常数因子近似的难度。
results: 证明了找到步速均衡的常数因子近似是PPAD-难的，这强化了先前只针对逆多项式近似的PPAD-难度结果。

title: A New Flexible Train-Test Split Algorithm, an approach for choosing among the Hold-out, K-fold cross-validation, and Hold-out iteration
authors: Zahra Bami, Ali Behnampour, Aniruddha Bora, Hassan Doosti
abstract:
Choosing an appropriate strategy for partitioning data into training and evaluation sets is a critical step in machine learning, yet validation methods are often selected using default or conventional settings without considering their impact on generalizability and real-world performance. Common approaches such as hold-out validation or k-fold cross-validation with fixed k values are frequently applied based solely on empirical practice.
  To address this issue, we propose a flexible Python-based framework that systematically examines how different validation strategies affect predictive performance across seven widely used machine learning algorithms, including Decision Trees, K-Nearest Neighbors, Naive Bayes variants, Logistic Regression, calibrated linear Support Vector Machines, and histogram-based gradient boosting. The framework evaluates these methods under a wide range of validation schemes, including hold-out splits from 10% to 90%, k-fold cross-validation with k between 3 and 15, repeated hold-out, and nested cross-validation.
  The framework is applied to three biomedical datasets of varying size, and performance is assessed using ROC-AUC, accuracy, and the Matthews correlation coefficient. The results show that no single validation strategy consistently outperforms others across all algorithms and datasets, indicating that optimal validation depends on the interaction between the algorithm, dataset characteristics, and evaluation metric.
zh_title: 一种新的灵活的训练-测试划分算法，用于在留出法、K折交叉验证和留出法迭代中进行选择
translation: 在机器学习中，选择合适的数据分区策略用于训练和评估是至关重要的一步，然而验证方法通常是使用默认或常规设置来选择的，而没有考虑它们对泛化性和实际性能的影响。诸如留出法验证或固定k值的k折交叉验证等常见方法经常仅凭经验实践而被应用。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个灵活的、基于Python的框架，系统地检查了不同的验证策略如何影响七种广泛使用的机器学习算法的预测性能，这些算法包括决策树、K近邻、朴素贝叶斯变体、逻辑回归、校准线性支持向量机和基于直方图的梯度提升。该框架在广泛的验证方案下评估了这些方法，包括10%到90%的留出法划分、k在3到15之间的k折交叉验证、重复留出法和嵌套交叉验证。该框架应用于三个不同大小的生物医学数据集，性能通过ROC-AUC、准确率和Matthews相关系数进行评估。结果表明，没有单一的验证策略能够在所有算法和数据集上持续表现优异，这表明最优验证方法取决于算法、数据集特征和评估指标之间的相互作用。
tldr: 提出了一个灵活的Python框架，系统性地比较了多种训练/测试数据划分策略（包括留出法、K折交叉验证和重复留出法）对七种ML算法在三个生物医学数据集上的性能影响，结果表明没有单一的最佳策略，最佳选择取决于算法、数据和评估指标的相互作用。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个灵活的、系统化的框架（可能是指标题中的“新灵活算法”），用于指导实践者选择最合适的训练/测试数据划分策略，而不是依赖于经验或默认设置。其重要性在于，它强调了验证策略本身对模型性能评估的决定性影响，打破了“一刀切”的验证惯例。局限性在于，框架的具体实现细节（如“新灵活算法”的内部逻辑，而非仅仅是比较工具）在摘要中描述不充分，且结论是依赖于特定算法和数据集（生物医学）得出的，可能不完全适用于所有机器学习领域。
motivation: 机器学习中，选择合适的数据划分策略（训练集和评估集）至关重要，但现有方法（如固定K值的留出法或K折交叉验证）通常是基于经验或默认设置选择的，未能充分考虑其对模型泛化能力和实际性能的影响。
method: 提出了一个灵活的、基于Python的框架，用于系统地检验不同验证策略如何影响七种常用机器学习算法（包括决策树、K近邻、朴素贝叶斯变体、逻辑回归、校准线性线性支持向量机和基于直方图的梯度提升）的预测性能。该框架评估了多种验证方案，包括10%到90%的留出法划分、k在3到15之间的K折交叉验证、重复留出法和嵌套交叉验证。研究使用了三个不同大小的生物医学数据集，性能通过ROC-AUC、准确率和Matthews相关系数进行评估。
results: 结果显示，没有单一的验证策略能够在所有算法和数据集上始终表现最佳。
conclusion: 最佳的验证策略取决于算法、数据集特征和评估指标之间的相互作用，不存在一个在所有情境下都表现最佳的单一策略。

title: AutoTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness in Large Vision Language Models for Autonomous Driving
authors: Shuo Xing, Hongyuan Hua, Xiangbo Gao, Shenzhe Zhu, Renjie Li, Kexin Tian, Xiaopeng Li, Heng Huang, Tianbao Yang, Zhangyang Wang, Yang Zhou, Huaxiu Yao, Zhengzhong Tu
abstract: Recent advancements in large vision language models (VLMs) tailored for autonomous driving (AD) have shown strong scene understanding and reasoning capabilities, making them undeniable candidates for end-to-end driving systems. However, limited work exists on studying the trustworthiness of DriveVLMs -- a critical factor that directly impacts public transportation safety. In this paper, we introduce AutoTrust, a comprehensive trustworthiness benchmark for large vision-language models in autonomous driving (DriveVLMs), considering diverse perspectives -- including trustfulness, safety, robustness, privacy, and fairness. We constructed the largest visual question-answering dataset for investigating trustworthiness issues in driving scenarios, comprising over 10k unique scenes and 18k queries. We evaluated six publicly available VLMs, spanning from generalist to specialist, from open-source to commercial models. Our exhaustive evaluations have unveiled previously undiscovered vulnerabilities of DriveVLMs to trustworthiness threats. Specifically, we found that the general VLMs like LLaVA-v1.6 and GPT-4o-mini surprisingly outperform specialized models fine-tuned for driving in terms of overall trustworthiness. DriveVLMs like DriveLM-Agent are particularly vulnerable to disclosing sensitive information. Additionally, both generalist and specialist VLMs remain susceptible to adversarial attacks and struggle to ensure unbiased decision-making across diverse environments and populations. Our findings call for immediate and decisive action to address the trustworthiness of DriveVLMs -- an issue of critical importance to public safety and the welfare of all citizens relying on autonomous transportation systems. We release all the codes and datasets in https://github.com/taco-group/AutoTrust.
zh_title: AutoTrust：自动驾驶大型视觉语言模型的可信度基准测试
translation: 针对自动驾驶（AD）的大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）的最新进展，展示了强大的场景理解和推理能力，使其成为端到端驾驶系统不可否认的候选者。然而，关于研究DriveVLMs可信度的工作有限——这是一个直接影响公共交通安全的关键因素。在本文中，我们引入了AutoTrust，一个针对自动驾驶大型视觉语言模型（DriveVLMs）的综合可信度基准测试，考虑了多样化的视角——包括信任度、安全性、鲁棒性、隐私和公平性。我们构建了最大的用于研究驾驶场景中可信度问题的视觉问答数据集，包含超过1万个独特场景和1.8万个查询。我们评估了六个公开可用的VLM，涵盖了从通用型到专业型、从开源到商业模型。我们详尽的评估揭示了DriveVLMs此前未被发现的易受可信度威胁的漏洞。具体来说，我们发现通用VLM（如LLaVA-v1.6和GPT-4o-mini）在整体可信度方面出人意料地优于为驾驶精调的专业模型。像DriveLM-Agent这样的DriveVLMs特别容易泄露敏感信息。此外，通用型和专业型VLM都仍然容易受到对抗性攻击，并且难以确保在不同环境和人群中的决策公正性。我们的发现要求立即采取果断行动来解决DriveVLMs的可信度问题——这对公共安全以及所有依赖自动驾驶系统的公民的福祉至关重要。我们将在https://github.com/taco-group/AutoTrust发布所有代码和数据集。
tldr: 引入AutoTrust，这是一个针对自动驾驶视觉语言模型（DriveVLMs）的综合可信度基准测试，涵盖了信任度、安全性、鲁棒性、隐私和公平性。构建了一个包含超过1万个场景和1.8万个查询的大型数据集。评估发现通用VLM在整体可信度上优于专用模型，但所有模型都容易受到攻击和偏差影响，凸显了解决DriveVLM可信度问题的紧迫性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于首次系统性地针对自动驾驶领域的视觉语言模型（DriveVLMs）提出了一个全面的可信度基准测试（AutoTrust）。在自动驾驶系统逐渐走向端到端模型的背景下，可信度（包括安全性、隐私和公平性）是其商业化和公众接受度的核心挑战。该研究通过构建一个大规模、多维度的视觉问答数据集，填补了现有研究的空白。最引人注目的发现是，通用VLM在整体可信度上竟然优于专业模型，这挑战了“专业模型必然更优”的传统认知，并暗示了现有DriveVLM微调方法可能过度关注性能而牺牲了关键的可信度特征。该工作对推动自动驾驶AI的安全发展具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 现有的自动驾驶大型视觉语言模型（DriveVLMs）展现出强大的场景理解和推理能力，但目前缺乏对其可信度的研究，而可信度是直接影响公共交通安全的关键因素。
method: 引入AutoTrust，一个综合的可信度基准测试，从信任度、安全性、鲁棒性、隐私和公平性等多个角度评估DriveVLMs。构建了最大的用于研究驾驶场景可信度问题的视觉问答数据集（超过1万个独特场景和1.8万个查询）。评估了六个公开可用的VLM（涵盖通用型到专业型、开源到商业模型）。
results: 揭示了DriveVLMs此前未被发现的漏洞。具体来说，通用VLM（如LLaVA-v1.6和GPT-4o-mini）在整体可信度方面出人意料地优于为驾驶定制的专业模型。DriveVLMs（如DriveLM-Agent）特别容易泄露敏感信息。此外，通用型和专业型VLM都容易受到对抗性攻击，并且难以确保在不同环境和人群中的决策公正性。
conclusion: 发现结果要求立即采取果断行动来解决DriveVLMs的可信度问题，这对公共安全以及所有依赖自动驾驶系统的公民的福祉至关重要。

title: ATRNet-STAR: A Large Dataset and Benchmark Towards Remote Sensing Object Recognition in the Wild
authors: Yongxiang Liu, Weijie Li, Li Liu, Jie Zhou, Bowen Peng, Yafei Song, Xuying Xiong, Wei Yang, Tianpeng Liu, Zhen Liu, Xiang Li
abstract: The absence of publicly available, large-scale, high-quality datasets for Synthetic Aperture Radar Automatic Target Recognition (SAR ATR) has significantly hindered the application of rapidly advancing deep learning techniques, which hold huge potential to unlock new capabilities in this field. This is primarily because collecting large volumes of diverse target samples from SAR images is prohibitively expensive, largely due to privacy concerns, the characteristics of microwave radar imagery perception, and the need for specialized expertise in data annotation. Throughout the history of SAR ATR research, there have been only a number of small datasets, mainly including targets like ships, airplanes, buildings, etc. There is only one vehicle dataset MSTAR collected in the 1990s, which has been a valuable source for SAR ATR. To fill this gap, this paper introduces a large-scale, new dataset named ATRNet-STAR with 40 different vehicle categories collected under various realistic imaging conditions and scenes. It marks a substantial advancement in dataset scale and diversity, comprising over 190,000 well-annotated samples, 10 times larger than its predecessor, the famous MSTAR. Building such a large dataset is a challenging task, and the data collection scheme will be detailed. Secondly, we illustrate the value of ATRNet-STAR via extensively evaluating the performance of 15 representative methods with 7 different experimental settings on challenging classification and detection benchmarks derived from the dataset. Finally, based on our extensive experiments, we identify valuable insights for SAR ATR and discuss potential future research directions in this field. We hope that the scale, diversity, and benchmark of ATRNet-STAR can significantly facilitate the advancement of SAR ATR.
zh_title: ATRNet-STAR：一个面向野外遥感目标识别的大型数据集和基准
translation: 由于缺乏公开的、大规模、高质量的合成孔径雷达自动目标识别（SAR ATR）数据集，严重阻碍了快速发展的深度学习技术的应用，而深度学习在该领域具有巨大的潜力。这主要是因为从SAR图像中收集大量多样化的目标样本成本极高，主要原因包括隐私问题、微波雷达成像感知的特性以及数据标注所需的专业知识。在SAR ATR研究的历史上，仅存在少数小型数据集，主要包括船只、飞机、建筑物等目标。其中只有一个车辆数据集MSTAR是在1990年代收集的，一直是SAR ATR领域宝贵的资源。为了填补这一空白，本文推出了一个名为ATRNet-STAR的大型新数据集，该数据集包含在各种现实成像条件和场景下收集的40种不同的车辆类别。它标志着数据集规模和多样性的实质性进步，包含超过190,000个良好标注的样本，是其前身著名MSTAR的10倍。构建如此大规模的数据集是一项具有挑战性的任务，本文将详细介绍数据收集方案。其次，我们通过在源自该数据集的具有挑战性的分类和检测基准上，利用7种不同的实验设置，广泛评估了15种具有代表性的方法的性能，从而说明了ATRNet-STAR的价值。最后，基于我们的广泛实验，我们为SAR ATR确定了有价值的见解，并讨论了该领域未来潜在的研究方向。我们希望ATRNet-STAR的规模、多样性和基准能够显著促进SAR ATR的进步。
tldr: 为了解决SAR ATR领域缺乏大型数据集的问题，本文推出了ATRNet-STAR，这是一个规模是MSTAR 10倍（19万样本）的新型车辆数据集。我们在其上对15种方法进行了基准测试，并提供了新的见解，以促进该领域的发展。
ai_comments: 该论文的核心创新在于创建了ATRNet-STAR数据集，直接解决了SAR ATR领域数据稀缺的关键瓶颈。通过提供一个比历史标准MSTAR大10倍、包含40种多样化车辆类别的真实条件数据集，作者极大地降低了深度学习研究人员的进入门槛。这项工作非常重要，因为它使得需要大量数据的现代深度学习技术得以应用，有望在“野外”SAR ATR的性能和鲁棒性方面带来范式转变。
motivation: 缺乏公开的、大规模、高质量的合成孔径雷达自动目标识别（SAR ATR）数据集，严重阻碍了深度学习技术的应用。现有的数据集规模小、多样性差（如MSTAR），且数据收集成本高昂，涉及隐私问题、微波雷达成像特性和专业标注需求。
method: 本文推出了一个名为ATRNet-STAR的大型新数据集，并详细介绍了其数据收集方案。随后，通过在数据集衍生的具有挑战性的分类和检测基准上，利用7种不同的实验设置，广泛评估了15种具有代表性的方法。
results: ATRNet-STAR包含40种不同的车辆类别，收集于各种现实成像条件和场景下，拥有超过190,000个良好标注的样本，规模是此前著名MSTAR数据集的10倍。基于广泛的实验，论文为SAR ATR领域确定了有价值的见解，并讨论了潜在的未来研究方向。
conclusion: ATRNet-STAR的规模、多样性和基准有望显著推动合成孔径雷达自动目标识别（SAR ATR）领域的进步。

title: A Gaussian Process View on Observation Noise and Initialization in Wide Neural Networks
authors: Sergio Calvo-Ordoñez, Jonathan Plenk, Richard Bergna, Alvaro Cartea, Jose Miguel Hernandez-Lobato, Konstantina Palla, Kamil Ciosek
abstract: Performing gradient descent in a wide neural network is equivalent to computing the posterior mean of a Gaussian Process with the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK-GP), for a specific prior mean and with zero observation noise. However, existing formulations have two limitations: (i) the NTK-GP assumes noiseless targets, leading to misspecification on noisy data; (ii) the equivalence does not extend to arbitrary prior means, which are essential for well-specified models. To address (i), we introduce a regularizer into the training objective, showing its correspondence to incorporating observation noise in the NTK-GP. To address (ii), we propose a \textit{shifted network} that enables arbitrary prior means and allows obtaining the posterior mean with gradient descent on a single network, without ensembling or kernel inversion. We validate our results with experiments across datasets and architectures, showing that this approach removes key obstacles to the practical use of NTK-GP equivalence in applied Gaussian process modeling.
zh_title: 宽神经网络中观测噪声和初始化的高斯过程视角
translation: 在宽神经网络中执行梯度下降等效于计算具有神经切线核（NTK-GP）的高斯过程的后验均值，但仅限于特定的先验均值和零观测噪声。然而，现有公式存在两个局限性：(i) NTK-GP假设目标无噪声，导致在有噪声数据上出现错误设定；(ii) 这种等效性不适用于任意先验均值，而任意先验均值对于构建良好设定的模型至关重要。为解决局限性(i)，我们在训练目标中引入了一个正则化器，证明了其对应于在NTK-GP中纳入观测噪声。为解决局限性(ii)，我们提出了一种“移位网络”，它能够实现任意先验均值，并允许通过对单个网络进行梯度下降来获得后验均值，而无需集合或核反演。我们通过跨数据集和架构的实验验证了我们的结果，表明这种方法消除了在应用高斯过程建模中实际使用NTK-GP等效性的关键障碍。
tldr: 宽神经网络（WNN）梯度下降与NTK-GP的等效性存在局限（无噪声目标，受限的先验均值）。本文引入正则化器处理噪声，并提出“移位网络”以实现任意先验均值，从而使NTK-GP等效性在实际应用中更具可行性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于提供了实用的、基于架构和正则化的解决方案（移位网络和正则化器），以弥合理论上的NTK-GP等效性与实际应用之间的差距。通过解决观测噪声和初始化灵活性问题，该论文使宽网络上的NTK视角成为应用于机器学习的更强大的工具，超越了纯粹的理论兴趣。
motivation: 现有将宽神经网络中的梯度下降等同于神经切线核高斯过程（NTK-GP）的公式存在两大局限：(i) NTK-GP假设目标无噪声，导致在有噪声数据上出现错误设定；(ii) 这种等效性不适用于任意先验均值，而任意先验均值对于构建良好设定的模型至关重要。
method: (i) 在训练目标中引入一个正则化器，证明其对应于在NTK-GP中纳入观测噪声。(ii) 提出一个“移位网络”，以实现任意先验均值，并允许通过对单个网络进行梯度下降来获得后验均值，无需集合或核反演。
results: 经验证，该方法消除了应用高斯过程建模中实际使用NTK-GP等效性的关键障碍。结果通过跨数据集和架构的实验得到了证实。
conclusion: 引入正则化器和移位网络成功解决了标准NTK-GP等效性的局限性（无噪声目标和受限先验均值），使其成为应用于高斯过程建模的实用工具。

title: The Curse of Depth in Large Language Models
authors: Wenfang Sun, Xinyuan Song, Pengxiang Li, Lu Yin, Yefeng Zheng, Shiwei Liu
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the Curse of Depth, a concept that highlights, explains, and addresses the recent observation in modern Large Language Models (LLMs) where nearly half of the layers are less effective than expected. We first confirm the wide existence of this phenomenon across the most popular families of LLMs such as Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, and Qwen. Our analysis, theoretically and empirically, identifies that the underlying reason for the ineffectiveness of deep layers in LLMs is the widespread usage of Pre-Layer Normalization (Pre-LN). While Pre-LN stabilizes the training of Transformer LLMs, its output variance exponentially grows with the model depth, which undesirably causes the derivative of the deep Transformer blocks to be an identity matrix, and therefore barely contributes to the training. To resolve this training pitfall, we propose LayerNorm Scaling (LNS), which scales the variance of output of the layer normalization inversely by the square root of its depth. This simple modification mitigates the output variance explosion of deeper Transformer layers, improving their contribution. Across a wide range of model sizes (130M to 7B), our experiments show that LNS consistently outperforms previous normalization and scaling techniques in enhancing LLM pre-training performance. Moreover, this improvement seamlessly carries over to supervised fine-tuning. All these gains can be attributed to the fact that LayerNorm Scaling enables deeper layers to contribute more effectively during training. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/lmsdss/LayerNorm-Scaling}{LayerNorm-Scaling}.
zh_title: 大型语言模型中的深度诅咒
translation:
在本文中，我们引入了“深度诅咒”这一概念，它强调、解释并解决了现代大型语言模型（LLMs）中近一半的层效果不如预期的最新观察。我们首先确认了这一现象在Llama、Mistral、DeepSeek和Qwen等最流行LLM家族中的广泛存在。我们的理论和实证分析表明，LLMs中深层失效的根本原因是Pre-Layer Normalization (Pre-LN) 的广泛使用。虽然Pre-LN稳定了Transformer LLMs的训练，但其输出方差随模型深度呈指数增长，这不希望地导致深层Transformer块的导数成为一个单位矩阵，因此对训练几乎没有贡献。为了解决这个训练陷阱，我们提出了层归一化缩放（LayerNorm Scaling, LNS），它将层归一化输出的方差与其深度的平方根成反比进行缩放。这种简单的修改减轻了更深层Transformer层的输出方差爆炸，提高了它们的贡献。在各种模型尺寸（130M到7B）上，我们的实验表明LNS在增强LLM预训练性能方面始终优于先前的归一化和缩放技术。此外，这种改进无缝地延续到监督微调。所有这些增益都可以归因于LayerNorm Scaling使更深层在训练期间更有效地贡献。我们的代码可在

LayerNorm-Scaling

获取。
tldr: 本文揭示并解决了大型语言模型中深层效果不佳的问题，发现Pre-Layer Normalization (Pre-LN) 导致输出方差指数增长，进而提出LayerNorm Scaling (LNS) 来有效提升深层贡献。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过识别Pre-LN作为“深度诅咒”的根本原因并提出LNS这一简洁有效的解决方案，为深度大型语言模型的训练稳定性与性能提升提供了重要见解。LNS的简单性及其在不同模型和任务上的普适性是其创新之处，对未来深度模型的设计具有指导意义。
motivation: 现代大型语言模型中近一半的层效果不如预期，需要理解、解释并解决这一“深度诅咒”现象。
method: 通过理论和实证分析，确认Pre-Layer Normalization (Pre-LN) 是导致深层Transformer块效果不佳的根本原因，因为它导致输出方差随深度指数增长，使深层梯度接近单位矩阵。为解决此问题，提出LayerNorm Scaling (LNS)，即通过将层归一化输出的方差与其深度平方根成反比进行缩放。
